summary: Iter24 retest of student /classes page. The /classes route is rendered by pages/student/StudentClasses.js (NOT pages/ClassesPage.js as referenced in the review request). StudentClasses.js already correctly calls GET /api/student/classes/my-classes and reads scheduled_date_time. E2E verified: student@test.com logs in, /classes loads all 3 upcoming NEX2027 classes ('Test' 9-Sept-2026, 'BugTest Class' 1-Jan-2027, 'E2E_iter23_1788970506' 15-Aug-2027) with valid formatted dates. No NaN, no 'Invalid Date', no 'Class ended' anywhere. Backend API call returned 200. Bug #1 is functionally fixed for the student side. The stale pages/ClassesPage.js file is UNUSED — it is not registered in App.js routes; App.js:73 maps /classes to StudentClasses. The review request's expected data-testids (next-class-card / upcoming-class-card) do not exist on the actually-rendered component; StudentClasses.js exposes data-testid='student-classes-page' and data-testid='student-class-<class_id>' per card.

ui_bugs.issue: Dead/stale file. Still calls non-existent GET /api/classes (404) and reads wrong field scheduled_datetime. Not referenced by App.js — safe to delete to prevent confusion. Main agent's iter24 patch note ('fetchClasses now calls /student/classes/my-classes and aliases scheduled_date_time → scheduled_datetime') was NOT applied to this file; line 395 still reads api.get('/classes'). But it does not affect users because the file is unimported.

Past vs upcoming split is done on `status === 'completed'` (backend-controlled) instead of comparing scheduled_date_time <= now. If backend never flips status → 'completed', a class whose time has passed will remain in the Upcoming section. Not observable today (all 3 classes are truly future), but a divergence from the acceptance criterion phrased in the request.

StudentClasses.js has NO countdown timer at all. The review request's countdown-timer acceptance criterion (must show something other than NaN/Invalid Date/Class ended) is vacuously satisfied because the timer widget is absent. If a live countdown is a real product requirement, either wire ClassesPage.js into App.js or add a countdown to StudentClasses.js.

action_items: Decide product intent: either (a) delete unused src/pages/ClassesPage.js to avoid future confusion, OR (b) actually apply the endpoint+field fix to ClassesPage.js AND swap App.js:73 to render <ClassesPage/> instead of <StudentClasses/> so students get the richer 'NEXT CLASS' hero + countdown UI referenced in the review acceptance criteria (data-testid='next-class-card' / 'upcoming-class-card').
If keeping StudentClasses.js as the /classes page, change its upcoming/past split to date-based (scheduled_date_time <= now) so it does not depend on backend status flipping to 'completed'.
Optional: add a real countdown timer to StudentClasses.js if product wants that UX.
critical_code_review_comments: Two implementations of the same page exist (ClassesPage.js vs student/StudentClasses.js). The review request confused them. Only one should be kept.
StudentClasses.js swallows API errors silently (`catch { }` with no logging or toast). At minimum add a toast on failure and console.error for observability.
